ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (15) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Разбойник» (razboynik, 'robber'), the man crucified beside Christ, is 'the robber' throughout rather than the traditional 'thief'; «неразумная / разумная жизнь» (nerazumnaya / razumnaya zhizn') is 'unreasonable / reasonable life', keeping the root of «разум» (razum, 'reason'). Confucius's italics on the three ways are restored, and the generic «каждым человеком в себе» (kazhdym chelovekom v sebe) is 'each person in himself'.
